# Smithsonian Magazine

> Smithsonian Magazine is a premier publication covering history, science, culture, and the arts with exclusive photography contests and membership offerings.

Smithsonian Magazine combines award-winning editorial content with reader engagement through annual photo contests and flexible subscription options. The publication serves millions of readers interested in American history, natural sciences, and cultural topics.

- Smithsonian Magazine

## Subscriptions & Membership

- [Subscribe to Smithsonian Magazine](https://subscribe.smithsonianmag.com): Main subscription and membership page offering flexible plans and member benefits
- [Subscribe to Smithsonian Magazine | Give a Gift](https://subscribe.smithsonianmag.com/gift): Gift subscription options with special offers and gift card packages

## Photo Contest

- [Welcome to the 2025 Smithsonian Magazine Photo Contest](https://photocontest.smithsonianmag.com/photocontest): 23rd Annual Smithsonian Magazine Photo Contest featuring finalist voting and reader choice awards
- [Flour, Feed and Seed](https://photocontest.smithsonianmag.com/photocontest/detail/flour-feed-and-seed): Photo contest entry showcasing Victorian granary architecture in historic Kinderhook, New York
